	set_variable = { global.pm_output_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 40 }
	set_variable = { global.pm_industrial_capacity_use@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.pm_construction_duration@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 30 }
	clear_array = global.pm_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor
	clear_array = global.pm_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor
	add_to_array = { global.pm_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor = token:electronics }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 2.5 }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor = token:computers }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 0.15 }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor = token:portable_power }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 3 }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor = token:machinery }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 1 }
	clear_array = global.pm_construction_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor
	clear_array = global.pm_construction_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor = token:services }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 25 }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor = token:composites }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 15 }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor = token:tools }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 20 }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor = token:machinery }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 200 }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input@token:pm_fusion_reactor = token:computers }
	add_to_array = { global.pm_construction_input_amount@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 15 }
	set_variable = { global.pm_workforce_laborers@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 0.5 }
	set_variable = { global.pm_workforce_workers@token:pm_fusion_reactor = 0.4 }
